basic_details.job_title: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Assistant and Field Investigator Posts

qualification.education_qualification: Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences/Education/Adult Education, Postgraduate/Graduate in Social Science
qualification.details: Research Assistant: Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences/ Education/ Adult Education or a related discipline with a minimum of 55% marks from a recognized university. Preference will be given to candidates who have qualified NET or possess an M.Phil. and Ph.D. The candidate should have excellent English writing skills, proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, SPSS, and other relevant data analysis software, along with sound knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies. Experience in data collection, analysis, interpretation, and report writing will be an added advantage. Field Investigator: Postgraduate/Graduate in any Social Science discipline with at least 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with a four-year under-graduate programme and prior field survey experience.

salary_details.details: Research Assistant: ₹37,000/- per month Field Investigator: ₹20,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MANUU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications for MANUU Recruitment 2026 is 14 August 2026. Ensure your application is sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by MANUU for the posts of Research Assistant and Field Investigator in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for the MANUU Recruitment 2026 by sending their complete application along with required documents via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant post will receive a salary of ₹37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Investigator post will receive a salary of ₹20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences/ Education/ Adult Education or a related discipline with at least 55% marks is required. NET qualification or M.Phil./Ph.D. is preferred.

faq.question: Q7. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate/Graduate degree in any Social Science discipline with at least 55% marks is required. A four-year undergraduate program and prior field survey experience are preferred.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for MANUU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts in MANUU Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview.
